stem:
The diagram shows Navya facing a plane mirror. She raises her left arm. The dashed figure is the image.

Which claim correctly applies lateral inversion?

options.text: In the image, the raised arm appears on the right side.
In the image, the raised arm appears to point downward instead of upward.
Ordinary lettering painted as AMBULANCE on a van would still read as AMBULANCE in a rear-view mirror ahead.
A photograph of Navya raising her left arm must show her raising her right arm.

teacher.key_rationale: Lateral inversion swaps left and right in a plane-mirror image, so a raised left arm appears on the right. Vertical flip, ordinary AMBULANCE reading in a rear-view mirror, or treating a photograph the same way miss that hinge.
teacher.figure_note: Plane mirror with object raising left arm and dashed image appearing to raise the right arm.
